_approach: Carnival call-and-response breakdown: cowbell tresillo and tambourine trade across the bar over a low congaLow pulse, a single soft kick opening bar 1 only, and everything else sitting at decoration velocity so the returning broken-4x4 floor and clap backbone feel like the carnival arriving. Ref: the broken-4x4 and tribal-conga approaches (ukfunky_broken_4x4_01, ukfunky_tribal_conga_01), Beatportal's "The Lasting Legacy of UK Funky" on the genre's carnival roots. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
